2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

1065-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-complete.text:
A note from Zamah?  Her needs must be great to send word from so far.  Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid!  I know exactly what to do!
1065-complete.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-accept.text:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
1066-accept.title: Blood of Innocents

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

503-accept.name: Krusk
503-accept.text: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large Syndicate base to the north, most likely in the Alterac Mountains. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.
503-accept.title: Gol'dir

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

533-accept.name: Krusk
533-accept.text:
At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large Syndicate camp just north of here.

Go there, $N, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
533-accept.title: Infiltration

533-complete.name: Krusk
533-complete.text: Finally, we know where Gol'dir is being held. The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
533-complete.title: Infiltration

533-progress.name: Krusk
533-progress.text: Have you found anything? I fear Gol'dir's prospects grow worse by the day...
533-progress.title: Infiltration

535-accept.name: Henchman Valik
535-accept.text:
Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.

No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
535-accept.title: Valik

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

552-accept.name: Novice Thaivand
552-accept.text:
Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him.  To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.

Such disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable.  As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.

We will need Helcular's Rod first.  Yeti overtook his ritual lair.  Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
552-accept.title: Helcular's Revenge

552-progress.name: Novice Thaivand
552-progress.text: Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet?  There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate.  But we must have it in order to proceed.
552-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

7321-accept.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-accept.text:
Who says that the $r don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...

Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
7321-accept.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

79947-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79947-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79947-complete.title: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth

79947-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79947-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79947-progress.title: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight
